summary: This resolution condemns the October 7, 2023, Hamas attacks, calls for Hamas to surrender and release all hostages, reaffirms Israel's right to self-defense, commits to providing humanitarian aid to Palestinian noncombatants, urges international condemnation of Hamas and calls for hostage release, and condemns antisemitism globally.
